name: digital-sanctuary
description: 本地优先的 Pixiv 资源管理、元素拦截与显式模型整理桌面应用
author: SilverLoli

scripts.build:core: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/database/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/vision/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && electron-vite dev --config apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:core && electron-vite build --config apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run build:vision-bundle && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:vision-bundle && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.test: npm run build:core && vitest run && npm run test:python
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
